x: We have a fine crowd of up and coming Juniors and welcome Bryan Cormick, George Barratt, M. Small and John Gilbert. May they look back with pride on the day they became "Bels".

Eric Hall was at the British Museum Newspaper library some while back, and delving into the "Sporting Clipper" for May 11th 1889 noted that at the Polytechnic H & CC Meeting on 4th May 1889 at Paddington Recreation Ground - J.
